hypothesis.title: Cross-strike, regionally detrended basement and gravity offsets as View A
hypothesis.mechanism: A buried fault may make a localized step in basement depth and/or isostatic gravity across its trace. The registered operator compares both sides along NNE/NW normals at 3 and 6 pixels after a 15-pixel regional detrend, then tests View A against the surface View B. This is a structural hypothesis, not a fault detector.
hypothesis.named_non_fault_mimic: Basin-margin or flexural hinge without displacement; basement lithology/density contact; model-grid or interpolation seam.
